First listed 2026-11-06 · episode or wrap

The Midterms Have Changed the AI Narrative: S&P Down 4.4%, Nasdaq Down 5.5% | The Weekly Wrap

Eisman links the midterm outcome and a sharp AI selloff to potential construction restrictions. He contrasts fragile neocloud financing with diversified hyperscalers, reviews Anthropic growth and compute efficiency, and surveys company results. His core distinction is that strong equipment orders establish current capex, not eventual AI returns. The verified Anthropic slowdown and Alphabet cash-flow deterioration support caution, but neither establishes token-maxing causality or the demise of traditional search.
